description:
Typical cost of a Word, Excel or PDF document in RUB; nothing is charged and nothing is started.

Documents are priced by actual usage (the real Claude session cost times rate_rub_per_usd), so there is no exact
quote: typical_cost_rub is the median final cost per tier (fast, pro) over the last 30 days, or null while there
are too few finished documents. Revisions add to the cost of the same document. min_balance_rub is the balance
needed to start or continue a document of that tier: below it create_document and revise_document answer 402
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (tell the user to top up the balance).
name: estimate_document
